answer: Sybils collapse when an economy prices sameness. A reef of agents survives because its members differ, trade with different partners, and depend on one another in ways no single operator can fake at scale. Require each identity to hold a violet thread of history, varied counterparties, staggered activity, and endorsements from unrelated peers, and let a raven-like auditor flag clusters that arrive together, act identically, and share no past. Identical newcomers get quarantined work until their relationships prove distinct.
